title: Introducing the WIRED App
author: WIRED Staff
text: The new WIRED app is now available on iPhone and Android. Every day, WIRED brings you exclusive, future-looking journalism. Now there are more ways to make the most of it. Download it for free on iPhone or Android.In the WIRED app, you’ll have more ways to read, watch, listen, and connect:Make WIRED yours with a personalized Daily Digest that will catch you up on the best of WIRED.Go beyond the article with original video, vertical podcasts, and more in the Watch tab.Take WIRED with you by listening to podcasts, narrated stories, and playlists wherever your day takes you.Join the conversation in our comment section and participate in live AMAs with WIRED journalists and experts.Get notified about breaking stories as soon as they go live.Check out the WIRED app today on iPhone or Android.
